text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"During a smooth-sailing summer training camp,
we arrived at the track for the final adjustments, when--"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Sakura Bakushin O was about to run as well, having arrived at the same track. The two exchanged glances for a brief moment—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, North Flight and
Sakura Bakushin O...
lined up together at the starting position.

text_block_list.name: Flight & Bakushin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a scene seen many times before—
The two competing, chasing, and being chased... each striving to get ahead of the other.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a sprint race that's over in the blink of an eye,
you can't let your guard down for a single moment. That's why the two of them
run at full speed, max throttle, right from the start—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always, Flight-san...!
But I will NEVER surrender the class rep position to you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Bakushin O-chan, you've gotten faster again.
Even more than at the Yasuda Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I must Bakushin at maximum power!
—To defeat you, that is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Speed is everything! That's all you need!
If you cross the finish line faster than anyone else, you win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: People generally think Sakura Bakushin O has a bit of an issue with the mile distance... but it seems she plans to overcome it by polishing her speed to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected, Bakushin O-chan is...
unwavering. Truly stylish.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll head straight toward the sparkle too!
Toward a total look that suits me even better—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nunu!? In that case, I'll go
more, more, more, more, more, more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: More, more, more, more, more, more――

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: All right, breathe here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Just you watch,
I'll get even faster--!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew!
Thank you for being in perfect sync with me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: 30 years.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You and I, competing for around 30 years.
You and I, getting faster and faster and faster—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Be it 2000m or 3600m!
I'll blast past everyone at top speed in any race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Overtaking both time and light, going beyond Bakushin!
If it's us, surely we can reach it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If the two of us can just keep running together like this,
running to the ends of the earth...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin O-chan.
choice_data_list: (Yeah, I can't just agree to that right away...)
(I can't just agree to that right away, can I...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Continuing to single-mindedly face her own raw materials, she knows reality all too well. Namely... that the raw materials themselves cannot be remade."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wearing whatever suits her best at that moment, adapting to the changes in her body shape and age. She is someone who truly embraces the natural constraints of what she was born with.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...Understood, let's think about it!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what I do, I'm helplessly changing...
How do I face who I'm becoming?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
By finding the most fitting coordinate for each moment,
you continually bring out the radiance of the material.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even if the way it shines changes,
the radiance itself remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Because we're fabulous! We'll definitely be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...I know, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll leave the thinking to Flight-san!
I'll do my best to stay full of energy at all times!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san is just as smart
and admirable as me!
Could that be why?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"You make me strong, fast, and the absolute best.
Guiding and being guided... it's a strange feeling!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
That is what... rivals are for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after training alongside Sakura Bakushin O, we continued our fulfilling workouts—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
But I'm not tired at all, you know.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
How strange... The desire to run more and more.
It's just like back then... yet it feels completely different.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It's not frustration or impatience...
I feel like I'm being guided by confidence."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight gazes into the distance.
Are those eyes reflecting... her past self, from the days when she couldn't give it her all?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I can get stronger and stronger.
I can become faster..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
More and more power keeps welling up inside me.
âWhenever I run alongside Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Would you like to do
a quiz after so long?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I'm taking good care of it, you know.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: The fact that you... were my rival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember quizzing each other back in the Junior Class...
trying to become a rival for her when she had no one else to push her to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It was truly
such a great comfort to me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Over my tender heart, once shielded only by strength...
you placed a gentle veil."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...And now?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right now... won't you give it your all for me?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If that's the case...
you should be able to answer, right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
May I ask you...
—a special, super-difficult question?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—What do you think, Trainer?
Only 10 seconds left until the deadline~
Te~n, ni~ne...
choice_data_list: Ah, just wait a little longer...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I will not wait!
—Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... I spent a delightful time until sunset
with a North Flight who seemed just a little more high-spirited than usual.
